mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my in-law suite project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience with ADU construction, checking references, reviewing their portfolio, and ensuring they are licensed and insured in California. Look for a contractor with a strong understanding of local zoning and building codes in your specific area, such as Walnut Creek or Concord. A preparation tip is to gather multiple bids and compare not just prices, but also the scope of work, proposed timelines, and the contractor's communication style. A reliable contractor will provide clear contracts and be transparent about potential challenges and solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on ADU experience, references, license, and insurance. Compare multiple bids for scope, timeline, and communication style to ensure a good fit.
